newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends two cents down at 14.94 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends two cents down at 14.94 rgt.

text.p: Tin price ended two cents lower at 14.94 ringgit ($5.98) a kg after falls in the London market prompted players to sideline, traders said.

"Prices were marked down on poor lead from London. There was no strong buying interest," a dealer said. Turnover was 96 tonnes against 92 on Tuesday, with buying mainly from Europe and Malaysia. The near-term price trend depends largely on tbe performance of the copper's trend in London.
The local price differential over London was at $65 a tonne premium against $45 a tonne yesterday.
